qualified_scope: Exact signed macOS arm64 CLI and three packaged helpers; eleven retained Decodex private-stdio consumers, one offline component-cache repair contract and 1197 affected package tests.
limits: Source review, artifact qualification, local tests, PR delivery and installed acceptance are separate.

Only macOS arm64 private stdio, the named native consumers and packaged helpers are qualified with synthetic loopback fixtures. No desktop app startup, installation, live-account/provider acceptance, physical audio, release, tag or publication.
No broad upstream source suite was run. Official CI observations are partial and contain failures; causes remain unknown and no generic upstream pass is claimed.
The steering fixture verifies live/cold exact IDs and no replay. It does not force the internal final-flush barrier; the reviewed upstream deterministic test is source evidence only.

The new history fixture verifies ordinary and attached fork cold resume and continuation with an intact managed ancestor copy. It does not qualify every compressed/corrupt lineage variant tested in upstream source.
Other historical test results remain bound to their original source/artifact/configuration. Earlier certified ranges and unrecovered historical claims are preserved.
Shared MCP, remote production execution, Guardian V3, HumanCommand and deferred product experiments remain outside current qualification.
No latency, throughput, memory, billing, cost or new dependency-security benchmark/audit.
